mapper.sql: select a.achievement_id as "achievementId", concat('LA-', a.achievement_id) as "managementNo", personnel.name as "teacherName", a.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", a.organization_code as "organizationCode", a.occurred_date as "occurredDate", a.achievement_detail as "achievementDetail", a.certification_status as "certificationStatus", a.attachment_ref as "attachmentRef", a.updated_at as "updatedAt", a.updated_by as "updatedBy" from lecture_achievements a join users u on u.user_id = a.created_by join korus_personnel_snapshots personnel on personnel.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.select: order by a.occurred_date desc, a.achievement_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from lecture_achievements a join users u on u.user_id = a.created_by
mapper.insert: insert into lecture_achievements (evaluation_year, management_item_code, organization_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, certification_status, attachment_ref, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{evaluationYear}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.organizationCode}, #{request.occurredDate}, #{request.achievementDetail}, #{request.certificationStatus}, #{request.attachmentRef}, #{userId}, #{userId}, #{request.changeReason})
mapper.update: update lecture_achievements set management_item_code=#{request.managementItemCode}, organization_code=#{request.organizationCode}, occurred_date=#{request.occurredDate}, achievement_detail=#{request.achievementDetail}, certification_status=#{request.certificationStatus}, attachment_ref=#{request.attachmentRef}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{userId}, change_reason=#{request.changeReason} where achievement_id=#{request.achievementId} and deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by) values ('LECTURE', #{achievementId}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{actionType}, #{reason}, #{userId})

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) values ('lecture_achievements', cast(#{achievementId} as varchar), #{changeType}, 'achievement_detail', #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{userId}, #{reason})
